title: HDSG Question Route v1
description: The admission classifier's output. A typed question is read by this call, whose grammar admits exactly one of three tokens, so the classifier decides only whether the message is about the surroundings and never produces content. IN_SCOPE admits the question to the unchanged answer pipeline with the whole Fact Packet available; the topic routing that once selected a subset of facts was withdrawn on 23 August 2026, because the entailment gate already checks after generation what the routing was guessing at before it.
